integrity: The proof independently specializes Sack's halfspace system to the rooted-star Hasse diagram, proves the coordinate change is isometric on the affine span, derives a sharp global radius bound from singleton tube facets, forces the unique center at equality, and proves every larger-tube facet is strictly farther away. Finite exact-arithmetic replay is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the rooted-star poset and Sack's explicit 2023 realization. It does not claim affine-invariant metric information for all permutohedral realizations or a general inradius theorem for arbitrary poset associahedra. A residual originality risk remains for an equivalent folklore observation about this symmetric cardinality-weighted realization.
title: Exact inradius of the rooted-star poset associahedron realization
